company.description: Flowtel provides AI-powered voice and chat agents that manage guest interactions and routine requests for hotels. The platform handles tasks such as reservations, room bookings, room service, dining, and service requests through natural language conversations. Its agents answer guest calls and web chats and can complete common workflows without staff intervention. Flowtel connects guests, staff, and hotel systems so that information flows automatically between front desk, operations, and property management tools. Hotel operators use Flowtel to streamline communication, reduce repetitive work for staff, and maintain consistent service across channels. The service targets hospitality businesses that want to automate routine guest communication while keeping human staff available for higher-value interactions.
